properties.value: Non-constant-time comparison practice across lnd: the flagship production site is HTLC preimage validation (lnwallet/channel.go:6576/6622 — RHash vs sha256(preimage)); other production comparisons operate on public values (chainhash, txids, payment hashes, ZeroHash sentinels), so no secret-dependent timing was found anywhere in this object. 64 sites confirmed as real digest ==/!= comparisons (with public-data or test-only context), 53 sites rejected as nil-check/empty-string/flag/name-comparison

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 69 sites are math/rand import declarations (aliased prand/mrand/mathRand); confirmed usage calls are non-security-purpose: fee-estimate randomization within min/max bounds (lnwallet/chainfee/estimator.go:925 prand.Int63n), DB retry jitter (sqldb/interfaces.go:140), invoice route-hop-hint shuffling (lnrpc/invoicesrpc/addinvoice.go:955 mathRand.Shuffle), autopilot preferential-attachment heuristics, and bulk test-data generation across *_test.go files. No security-purpose randomness found: eve

All Shor-vulnerable: signatures are a deadline problem (forge-later), the handshake and onion ECDH are harvest-now-decrypt-later. Migration is const

properties.name: pqs:context

Symmetric MAC, quantum-adequate (A+); live op chains per AST — no migration required.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: lnd's tor integration identifies onion-service keys by the ED25519-V3 control-port tag (constant V3KeyParam, cmd_onion.go:40); tor v3 onion service identity keys are ed25519, and the private key file is stored by lnd. Key generation/signing is performed inside the tor daemon — observable here, replaceable only by the tor project. Quantum-vulnerable signature/key scheme; most other sites are the tag literal in unit-test mock commands.

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.26.8)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All TLS session endpoints of lnd: the shared server config (cert/tls.go TLSConfFromCert with pinned ECDHE-ECDSA cipher suites and TLS 1.2 floor), the generic tls.Listen wrapper, lncli's default-settings gRPC client, the fee estimator's HTTPS client, the itest harness, and the internal REST→gRPC loopback dial with InsecureSkipVerify (same-process, documented mitigation). Go 1.26.8 gives TLS 1.3 ML-KEM hybrid for capable peers; the TLS 1.2 floor keeps classical ECDHE-ECDSA available for older peer

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1) is the curve of the ECDSA keygen that mints lnd's self-signed gRPC/REST TLS certificate: cert/selfsigned.go:230 (production) and tls_manager_test.go:288 (test). Same call chain as the ECDSA object ALG-507434ae at those lines — kept as the curve facet so the CBOM records secp256r1. Retroactively breakable under Shor; replaceable here (own TLS PKI) with a hybrid ML-DSA-65 certificate chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MinVersion TLS 1.2 in the shared server config (cert/tls.go:101) — sessions admitted at 1.2 use classical-only ECDHE-ECDSA key exchange; hybrid ML-KEM groups require TLS 1.3. Changeable here (raise MinVersion), at the cost of dropping pre-1.3 clients.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is lnd's universal hash: payment preimage hashes (BOLT11), chainhash/txid computation, the Noise handshake digest (protocol name "Noise_XK_secp256k1_ChaChaPoly_SHA256" pinned at brontide/noise.go:26), HKDF-Hash in the Brontide key schedule (noise.go:200,248,736), onion-error digests (lnwire FailInvalidOnion*), shachain revocation-preimage chain derivation, bolt12 offer hashes, witness-cache keys. Grover yields only a square-root speedup (128-bit preimage security remains), and SHA-256 is

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF-SHA256 is the Noise key schedule of the brontide transport (BOLT-8): initialization from the protocol name, MixKey rekeying during the handshake, and post-ECDH traffic-key derivation. Quantum-safe itself, but it consumes the Shor-vulnerable secp256k1 ECDH output, so session secrecy rides on the handshake's migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt (N=32768/r=8/p=1, 32-byte key) protects the aezeed cipherseed — lnd's wallet seed mnemonic encryption at rest. The scrypt key feeds AEZ5 (aez.Encrypt, cipherseed.go:347), reported as a separate finding since the regex pass could not see it. Default passphrase "aezeed" (line 113) applies when the user provides none; by design the mnemonic entropy is the secret.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 appears twice in the TLS allowlist (CBC-SHA256 and GCM-SHA256 suites). Quantum-resistant but below CNSA 2.0's 256-bit preference.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA256 keyed MACs: chanstate/taproot.go:46 derives the revocation-root tweak for taproot channel commitments (spec-mandated derivation, real protocol security control); tor/controller.go:627 computes the Tor control-port SAFECOOKIE challenge hash for authentication. HMAC-SHA256 retains 128-bit security under Grover — quantum-adequate, no migration needed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM suites (128-GCM-SHA256, 256-GCM-SHA384) carry the AEAD traffic protection for lnd's TLS sessions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD across lnd's session and payload encryption: Brontide Noise_XX_25519 peer transport (brontide/noise.go), lnencrypt ECIES sealing (lnencrypt/crypto.go), watchtower justice-kit encryption, and the TLS 1.3 ChaCha20 suite in cert/tls.go's live suite list. 256-bit-key symmetric AEAD — not Shor-vulnerable (A+); no migration required.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-GCM-SHA384 — the strongest suite in lnd's allowlist; Grover leaves a comfortable 128-bit margin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto/chacha20poly1305 declared at v0.54.0 (go.mod sub-package declaration): the AEAD used by Brontide transport, lnencrypt ECIES and watchtower justice kits — symmetric, 256-bit, quantum-adequate (A+). Canonical entry for this declaration; the LIB-728a10dd duplicate is linked to it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto/rand (OS CSPRNG) is lnd's entropy source for security-critical randomness: wallet-seed entropy (aezeed/cipherseed.go), TLS cert keygen/serials (cert/selfsigned.go), funding batch keys, HTLC link salts, invoice/preimage paths, discovery. All key/nonce generation flows use the correct source — no weak-RNG posture in production. Randomness survives quantum attack; the correct inventory note is that this object is the GOOD twin of the math/rand object ALG-7d1fdc12.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 lifecycle for lnd's self-signed ECDSA P-256 TLS identity: private-key marshalling at cert/selfsigned.go:276, key-pair load and certificate parsing for the gRPC/REST listener (cert/tls.go:55,62,87), lncli profile trust-root ingestion (cmd/commands/profile.go:45), and remote-signer client CA pool (lnwallet/rpcwallet/remote_signer_connection.go:255), plus cert-rotation tests (tls_manager_test.go). The layer itself is not quantum-vulnerable — the Shor exposure rides on the ECDSA signature algo

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto v0.54.0 (direct dep, go.mod): the crypto library layer of the build — supplies HKDF, scrypt, ChaCha20-Poly1305 and nacl primitives consumed by brontide, aezeed, lnencrypt and watchtower. Note for migration planning: x/crypto v0.54.0 contains no PQ KEM/signature packages; PQ capability in this image comes from the Go 1.26.8 standard library (crypto/mlkem, crypto/mldsa). Canonical entry for the duplicate ALG-2bf2e623.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto/scrypt sub-package (via x/crypto v0.54.0, direct): the memory-hard KDF protecting the aezeed wallet seed — scrypt.Key(passphrase, salt, N=32768, r=8, p=1) stretches the optional user passphrase to the 32-byte key that feeds AEZ encipherment (aezeed/cipherseed.go:324). N=32768/r=8/p=1 meets OWASP-era recommendations for scrypt; quantum-irrelevant. First-party algorithm usage is recorded under scout 1's scrypt object (ALG-c1f8b585); this entry is the declared-dependency facet.
